definitions.gloss: spirited; strong-willed; outdoing men (of a woman or girl)
definitions.explanation: Said of a woman or girl who is bold, tough or strong-minded, in a way once thought to belong to men. Usually admiring, sometimes teasing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{姉|あね}→姉：00571_ane⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{男勝|おとこまさ}りだ。
examples.english: My older sister is a tough one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{男勝|おとこまさ}りな⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦はっきり→はっきり：01228_hakkiri⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: She has a strong-minded character and speaks plainly to anyone.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ころ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{男勝|おとこまさ}りだった⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}り{盛|も}り→切り盛り：18640_kirimori⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother, a tough girl since childhood, ran the shop single-handed.

notes:
⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧ (man) + {勝|まさ}り (being superior), from ⟦{勝|まさ}る→勝る：11848_masaru⟧: "surpassing a man."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {男勝|おとこまさ}りな⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: a strong-minded character
- {男勝|おとこまさ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧: a spirited woman

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {姉御肌|あねごはだ}: big-sisterly, a woman who takes charge and looks after others
- ⟦おてんば→おてんば：09098_otenba⟧: tomboyish; of a lively girl
- ⟦{女々|めめ}しい→女々しい：33176_memeshii⟧: unmanly, of a man; the gendered counterpart in reverse
